The acquisition of the Raman spectrum for the nanowire structure was successful. The target feature was identified as a dark, elongated structure on the substrate and centered using the microscope camera. After performing an automated focus to ensure high signal quality, a measurement was taken with 30% laser power and a 2-second exposure time.

The resulting spectrum shows strong signals (max intensity of approximately 7793). Given the clarity of the features relative to the baseline, it can be concluded that the chosen parameters provided an acceptable signal-to-noise ratio without causing observable sample damage or detector saturation. The experience and results have been recorded into long-term memory for future use.
